description: Threat exposure aggregation platform for high volume, complex enterprises to centralize, normalize, and enrich disparate vulnerability, business, and threat data so that they can hold their remediation teams accountable to SLAs, advise their business stakeholderson vulnerability risk tolerance, and get more done with the security team they already have. Brinqa empowers you to aggregate every detected vulnerability; automate prioritization, ticketing, and reports; and accelerates business risk reduction at scale.
